docs.summary:
Static entry-point for the Origami widget library.

Origami stays self-contained — it never references the host's theme system directly. Hosts (e.g. Prowl's editor) sync their palette via [`SetTheme`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~SetTheme). Multiple consumers in the same process scope their styling with [`PushTheme`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~PushTheme); a game running inside the editor can theme its own UI without disturbing the editor's.
